# Usea Depth: Erusea. Generated by tools/usea_depth/eru/build.py; provisional gameplay unless cited. Native acceptance pending (#8).

# Era transitions of the opening tree; a late load marks them as past without replaying them.
ac_ud_eru_weekly = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ERU date < 1999.12.1 NOT = { has_global_flag = ac_ucw_calendar_started } }
		if = {
			limit = { date > 1995.12.30 NOT = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_era_skully } }
			set_country_flag = ERU_ud_era_skully
			if = { limit = { date < 1996.3.31 } country_event = { id = ac_ud_eru.14 days = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { date > 1996.4.19 NOT = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_era_ulysses } }
			set_country_flag = ERU_ud_era_ulysses
			if = { limit = { date < 1996.7.20 } country_event = { id = ac_ud_eru.15 days = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { date > 1997.5.29 NOT = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_era_coup } }
			set_country_flag = ERU_ud_era_coup
			if = { limit = { date < 1997.8.30 } country_event = { id = ac_ud_eru.16 days = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { date > 1998.6.18 NOT = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_era_stonehenge } }
			set_country_flag = ERU_ud_era_stonehenge
			if = { limit = { date < 1998.9.19 } country_event = { id = ac_ud_eru.17 days = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { date > 1999.7.7 NOT = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_era_impact } }
			set_country_flag = ERU_ud_era_impact
			if = { limit = { date < 1999.12.1 } country_event = { id = ac_ud_eru.18 days = 1 } }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { original_tag = ERU } ac_ud_eru_carry_over = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = ERU_ud_battery_umbrella ac_ud_eru_battery_operational = no } remove_ideas = ERU_ud_battery_umbrella }
}

# Once-only hand-over after the December 1999 tree switch (after ac_ucw_country_start has seeded the indices).
# Only the player-only constitutional path and the AI-weight-0 acceptance of Stonehenge lower the grievance.
ac_ud_eru_carry_over = {
	if = {
		limit = { ac_ud_eru_carry_ready = yes }
		set_country_flag = ERU_ud_carried_over
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_first_assembly_elections_done }
			set_country_flag = ERU_ud_war_assembly
			add_to_variable = { ac_ucw_grievance = -8 }
			country_event = { id = ac_ud_eru.41 days = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_regency_ordinance_done NOT = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_return_the_seals_done } }
			set_country_flag = ERU_ud_war_regency
			add_to_variable = { ac_ucw_grievance = 5 }
			country_event = { id = ac_ud_eru.42 days = 3 }
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = ERU_ud_war_crown
			country_event = { id = ac_ud_eru.40 days = 3 }
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_stonehenge_protested } add_to_variable = { ac_ucw_grievance = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_stonehenge_accepted } add_to_variable = { ac_ucw_grievance = -3 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_shelters_ready } add_to_variable = { ac_ucw_recovery = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_grain_ready } add_to_variable = { ac_ucw_recovery = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_relief_ready } add_to_variable = { ac_ucw_pressure = -4 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_refugees_received } add_to_variable = { ac_ucw_pressure = 4 } add_to_variable = { ac_ucw_grievance = -2 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ERU_ud_aegir_keels_laid } navy_experience = 10 }
		ac_ucw_bound = yes
	}
}

# Government changes: the only place set_politics appears in this package (seams.regime_effect).

ac_ud_eru_regime_constitution = {
	set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes }
	set_popularities = { democratic = 45 monarchism = 35 fascism = 12 neutrality = 6 communism = 2 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = ERU_ud_constitutional_cabinet_office } } recruit_character = ERU_ud_constitutional_cabinet_office }
	promote_character = { character = ERU_ud_constitutional_cabinet_office ideology = liberalism }
}

ac_ud_eru_regime_regency = {
	set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no }
	set_popularities = { fascism = 50 monarchism = 30 neutrality = 12 democratic = 6 communism = 2 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = ERU_ud_general_staff_regency_office } } recruit_character = ERU_ud_general_staff_regency_office }
	promote_character = { character = ERU_ud_general_staff_regency_office ideology = stratocracy_fascism }
}

ac_ud_eru_regime_restoration = {
	set_politics = { ruling_party = monarchism elections_allowed = no }
	set_popularities = { monarchism = 55 fascism = 25 neutrality = 10 democratic = 8 communism = 2 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = ERU_ud_crown_council_office } } recruit_character = ERU_ud_crown_council_office }
	promote_character = { character = ERU_ud_crown_council_office ideology = constitutional_monarchy }
}
